name: Ultrasonic Distance Sensor
description: Like a bat's echolocation ears! Emits high-frequency ultrasonic chirps and measures the echo return time.
realWorldAnalogy: Like a bat's echolocation ears! Emits high-frequency ultrasonic chirps and measures the echo return time.
wiringGuidance: Connect VCC (Red wire) to 5V power rail, GND (Dark Slate wire) to GND. Connect TRIG (Green wire) to digital pin 9 and ECHO (Green wire) to digital pin 10.
commonMistakes: Swapping TRIG and ECHO pins will result in continuous 0cm readings.
Powering HC-SR04 with 3.3V causes erratic or missing distance pings—it requires a full 5V supply.

miniExperiment.title: Ultrasonic Ping Ruler
miniExperiment.circuit: VCC to 5V (Red), GND to GND (Dark Slate), TRIG to Pin 9 (Green), ECHO to Pin 10 (Green).
miniExperiment.expectedOutput: Distance in centimeters printed in Serial Monitor (e.g. 'Distance: 18 cm'). Move your hand closer to see the number decrease.
